query: How should we define the primary outcome precisely (e.g., adult-equivalent fruit servings/day), and what exact household-to-per-capita/adult-equivalent conversion and portion-size method should be used to harmonize Vietnam and Nigeria?

response.query: How should we define the primary outcome precisely (e.g., adult-equivalent fruit servings/day), and what exact household-to-per-capita/adult-equivalent conversion and portion-size method should be used to harmonize Vietnam and Nigeria?
response.answer: Define primary outcome as adult-equivalent fruit servings per day. Use household-to-per-capita conversion based on average adult fruit portion sizes. Harmonize Vietnam and Nigeria data using standardized portion sizes.
